ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity dark field across the medial and lateral regions. High-intensity (white) contiguous pigmentation is localized at the distal lower-left margin. Numerous discrete high-intensity circular blobs (3-12 pixel diameter) are scattered across the dark-field surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a more jagged, irregular topography compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex arc towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered high-contrast circular pixel groups localized on the far left distal tip and scattered across the central ventral region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/indentation on the upper-right trailing edge boundary, signifying potential historical tissue loss or mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique large white pigmentation patch on the ventral surface of the left fluke tip extending to the margin.
